request: Add a camel_to_snake helper to the code generator and use it wherever names are converted.

summary.result_text:
I added `camel_to_snake` to `tools/codegen/extension_sdk_typescript.py`, but nothing calls it yet. I didn't run it, because the check I tried needed approval.

The generator only converts snake_case to camelCase. That happens through the existing `_camel`, used for field names and for the `host_name` values in the method metadata and host/SDK types. Nothing converts camelCase to snake_case, so I left every `_camel` call as it is. Swapping any of them would reverse the generated output.

The helper sits just above `_ts_property`. It turns `getWalletId` into `get_wallet_id` and `HTTPServer` into `http_server`. Names already in snake_case pass through unchanged.

If you meant something else by "wherever names are converted", tell me which conversion you want it used for and I'll wire it in. I haven't run `make check` or any other Makefile target.
